about_the_game:
Storyline.

George Prinkerton, expecting nothing terrible about the new day, finds himself caught in a time loop. Shocking events unfold one after another, and what seemed to be a completely ordinary young man becomes trapped in a terrifying whirlwind of events. The clock hands relentlessly continue their countdown to the next tragedy, giving our hero not a moment's rest. Will you help him escape this predicament, or will you drag him into something greater? You must save his childhood friend from inevitable death! And here everything depends on you. Immerse yourself in the captivating reading of the visual novel and uncover the secrets of Hateful Days!

Graphics.

Immersing yourself in a unique world of black-and-white tones with vibrant strokes of primary colors, you will be able to notice the carefully conceived details of the city. Here you will encounter multi-story buildings, modest five-story apartment blocks, and unique locations that give this place an inimitable character. This city truly comes alive before your eyes

Sprites and CG illustrations.

The multitude of sprites and artwork in the game are not only an important element of style but also a key means of conveying the events and mood of the game. They play a special role in the narrative, helping to emphasize the personality and character of the characters. Although most sprites in the game are rendered in black-and-white tones, other shades are sometimes encountered, which add variety and highlight the distinctive features of each character.

Factions.

You await an encounter with various factions in the city, and only you will decide which side you are on. Think twice, because your choice may become your worst nightmare!

Characters.

Vanessa Lemington.

The best friend of the main character in our story possesses a beautiful appearance, a sweet voice, and charming personality traits. She loves watching anime, trying foreign dishes, and admires the famous idol from Batory, Izumi Itatsu. Now it is up to you to save her from a series of sudden tragic deaths. Be resolute and do not let her die in vain!

George Prinkerton.

George is a college student aspiring to become a detective, following in the footsteps of his parents, who are the owners of the Prinkerton Detective Agency. His intellect and quick-wittedness leave no doubt about his abilities, and his composure and determination make him unshakeable in any situation. Nothing can break him! Or so it seems?

Features of the game:

•Excellent music.

•Vocal compositions.

•50+ backgrounds

•50+ story illustrations.

•Interesting non-linear plot with multiple endings.

•Atmospheric immersion.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains rude expressions, scenes of violence and murders in a censored form. Watch and play at your own risk.
